title: Fernleaf app standup — Tuesday 2026-10-06 (synthetic)

transcript.speaker: Dana
transcript.text: Morning everyone, let's keep this quick. Priya, do you want to start?

transcript.speaker: Priya
transcript.text: Sure. Yesterday I finished the new onboarding screens, they're in code review now.

transcript.speaker: Priya
transcript.text: The open question is whether we ship them to everyone in 4.2 or put them behind a flag.

transcript.speaker: Marcus
transcript.text: I'd go with a flag. The last onboarding change hurt day-one retention for a week before anyone noticed.

transcript.speaker: Dana
transcript.text: Agreed. We ship the onboarding redesign in 4.2 behind a feature flag and ramp it up from ten percent.

transcript.speaker: Priya
transcript.text: Okay. I'll write the rollout plan for the flag: the ramp steps and which metrics we watch.

transcript.speaker: Dana
transcript.text: Can you have the rollout plan by Thursday?

transcript.speaker: Priya
transcript.text: Thursday works.

transcript.speaker: Marcus
transcript.text: On my side, the settings screen still crashes on older Android versions.

transcript.speaker: Marcus
transcript.text: It's a null pointer when the notification permission was never requested. I have a fix locally.

transcript.speaker: Dana
transcript.text: Can the fix go out tomorrow?

transcript.speaker: Marcus
transcript.text: Yes, I'll get the settings crash fix merged by tomorrow.

transcript.speaker: Jo
transcript.text: For support, I need the release notes before we submit 4.2. Last time support saw the notes the same day as users.

transcript.speaker: Dana
transcript.text: Jo, can you draft the 4.2 release notes and send them to the support team?

transcript.speaker: Jo
transcript.text: Yes, I'll send the release notes draft to support by Friday.

transcript.speaker: Marcus
transcript.text: One more thing. The Android tablet layout is nowhere near done, it needs at least two more weeks.

transcript.speaker: Priya
transcript.text: Honestly it doesn't block anything in 4.2.

transcript.speaker: Dana
transcript.text: Then we drop the tablet layout from this sprint and plan it for the next one.

transcript.speaker: Marcus
transcript.text: Fine by me. That frees up time for the crash backlog.

transcript.speaker: Jo
transcript.text: Nice. Support will be happy about fewer crash tickets.

transcript.speaker: Dana
transcript.text: Okay, that's everything. Thanks all.

decisions: Ship the onboarding redesign in 4.2 behind a feature flag, ramping up from ten percent
Drop the Android tablet layout from this sprint and plan it for the next sprint

actions.text: Write the rollout plan for the onboarding feature flag
Merge the fix for the settings screen crash on older Android versions
Send the 4.2 release notes draft to the support team
